songs.title: Whose House (Houston Cougars)
songs.genre: Stadium hip-hop anthem, Houston rap, marching-band drumline and brass stabs over heavy 808 bass, hard boom-bap drums, gang vocal chorus, crowd chants
songs.extra: Houston hip-hop stadium anthem, no guitars anywhere. Beat: live marching-band drumline (snare rolls, tom hits, bass drum) locked with a deep 808 sub bass and hard boom-bap kick and snare; marching-band brass section plays the stabs and the hook melody; crowd stomps and claps on 2 and 4. Verses: one lead rapper, confident Houston swagger, hard clear consonants, every word intelligible, no crowd under the verses. Pre-chorus: brass rises, snare roll, hard drop into the hook. Chorus: lead rapper shouting with a big gang-vocal crowd behind him, stadium reverb. Chant sections are crowd only. The first two Whose house call-and-answers are steady, one call then one answer, with a clear gap between them. The held section is SUNG, not chanted: the crowd sings each word as one long sustained note, Whose for two seconds, house for two seconds, Coogs for three seconds, house for three seconds, like the last line of an anthem before kickoff. Lines tagged lead rapper alone are one clear voice with no crowd layer. End on a drumline cadence and the crowd, not a fade. Pronounce Coogs to rhyme with moves, TDECU as the letters T-D-E-C-U, Yeoman as YO-man.
songs.avoid: rock, guitars of any kind, distorted guitar, power chords, punk, metal, pop-punk, country, acoustic instruments, piano ballad, slow tempo, soft or breathy vocals, autotune, mumbled or slurred lyrics, skipping lines, repeating a verse twice, fade-out ending, female lead, child voices, sad or melancholy mood, mentioning any other team or city, altering the lyrics or adding ad-libs that are not written
songs.lyrics:
[Intro chant, crowd only, drumline underneath, two steady call-and-answers 8s]
Whose house? ... Coogs' house!
Whose house? ... Coogs' house!

[Intro chant held, SUNG not chanted, crowd holds each word as one long note, drumline roll underneath 10s]
Whoooooooooose..... hoooooooooouse?..... Coooooooooooooogs'..... hoooooooooouse!

[Intro tag, lead rapper alone, crowd silent, clear articulated spoken shout, every word distinct 5s]
Scarlet and white! Third Ward! Houston, Texas!

[Verse 26s]
Down on Cullen Boulevard the ground starts shakin'
Forty thousand deep, TDECU's wakin'
Since 1927 we been buildin' this thing
Shasta's on the prowl, hear the whole city sing
Fold that ring finger, throw the Paw to the sky
A cougar lost a toe, now the legend won't die
One-thirty-two to one-forty, lower bowl, hear it swell
Student section on its feet, loudest in the Big 12

[Pre-Chorus 8s]
Spirit of Houston, brass hits like thunder
Red Out in the stands, we gon' pull 'em under
Hands up, Paw up, Houston on the rise
Look 'em in the eye and go

[Chorus, gang vocals 16s]
Eat 'em up, Coogs, eat 'em up!
Whose house? Coogs' house!
Eat 'em up, Coogs, eat 'em up!
Scarlet and white, we don't back down!
Go Coogs! Go Coogs!
H-Town's team, we run this town!

[Post-Chorus, crowd chant over brass 6s]
Houston! (Houston!) Houston! (Houston!)
Paw up, red out, this is Coog town!

[Verse 26s]
Yeoman drew the veer, changed the game forever
Andre Ware took the Heisman, '89, best ever
Keenum threw it up, records fell like rain
New names on the jersey, same fire, same flame
Cougar Red Friday, whole city in the colors
Third Ward to the Bay, we ride for each other
Nobody gave us nothin', we took it, that's the story
Houston built on grit, Houston built for glory

[Pre-Chorus 8s]
Spirit of Houston, brass hits like thunder
Red Out in the stands, we gon' pull 'em under
Hands up, Paw up, Houston on the rise
Look 'em in the eye and go

[Chorus, gang vocals 16s]
Eat 'em up, Coogs, eat 'em up!
Whose house? Coogs' house!
Eat 'em up, Coogs, eat 'em up!
Scarlet and white, we don't back down!
Go Coogs! Go Coogs!
H-Town's team, we run this town!

[Post-Chorus, crowd chant over brass 6s]
Houston! (Houston!) Houston! (Houston!)
Paw up, red out, this is Coog town!

[Drumline Break, instrumental, crowd clapping on 2 and 4 8s]

[Bridge, half-time, crowd call and response 16s]
When I say Cougar, you say Pride!
Cougar! (Pride!) Cougar! (Pride!)
When I say Houston, you say Fight!
Houston! (Fight!) Houston! (Fight!)
Scott Street to I-45, Third Ward to the Bay
Spirit of Houston in the house, every Coog, stand up and say

[Final Chorus, full stadium, key up 16s]
Eat 'em up, Coogs, eat 'em up!
Whose house? Coogs' house!
Eat 'em up, Coogs, eat 'em up!
Scarlet and white, we don't back down!
Go Coogs! Go Coogs!
H-Town's team, we run this town!

[Chorus repeat, crowd only, drums and claps 10s]
Eat 'em up, Coogs, eat 'em up!
Whose house? Coogs' house!
Eat 'em up, Coogs, eat 'em up!
Scarlet and white, we don't back down!

[Outro chant, crowd only, drumline cadence, two steady call-and-answers 8s]
Whose house? ... Coogs' house!
Whose house? ... Coogs' house!

[Outro chant held, SUNG not chanted, crowd holds each word as one long note, final drum hit 10s]
Whoooooooooose..... hoooooooooouse?..... Coooooooooooooogs'..... hoooooooooouse!

[Outro tag, lead rapper alone, crowd silent, clear spoken shout 2s]
Go Coogs!
